card.name: Verbs leading to 'set up' or 'establish'
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'up' or 'establish', such as 'set' in 'set up', or 'proposes to' and 'was' before 'established'. It appears in web text about governments or bodies creating committees, agencies or institutions.

modes.label: 'set' before 'up'
modes.description: The verb 'set' where an organisation or committee is being created.
modes.example: In 1982, the Andhra Pradesh government<< set>> up the Kolleru Lake Development Committee

modes.label: Intent or passive before establish
modes.description: A helper word like 'to', 'proposes' or 'was' right before 'establish(ed)'.
modes.example: the Government proposes<< to>> establish, from the beginning of 2

modes.label: Founding verb subject
modes.description: A body or subject word just before a creating verb such as 'created'.
modes.example: the United Nations (UN) General<< Assembly>> created the World Commission on Environment and Development

card.writes: It pushes the model to output 'establish', 'establishment' and the Chinese 'to build/establish' words.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that a government or group is setting up or establishing a new body.
